title: aspidium acrostichoides
intro: Aspidium acrostichoides, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, Aspidium acrostichoides is thought to have antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic actions, which may help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
